gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma, radiographically or pathologically diagnosed recurrence.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Low-dose Radiotherapy Combined With Sintilimab and Temozolomide:  (interventions: Drug: Sintilimab; Radiation: Low-dose Radiotherapy)
explore the efficacy and safety of low-dose radiotherapy combined with programmed death 1 (PD-1) inhibitor (sintilimab) and temozolomide in recurrent glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: The eligible patients are scheduled to administered sintilimab 200mg D1 Q3W temozolomide 50mg/m2 QD and radiotherapy 1Gy/1F D1/D2/D8/D15 Q3W for 4-6 cycles, then sintilimab for maintenance.

arms: Low-dose Radiotherapy Combined With Sintilimab and Temozolomide

role_evidence.quote: The eligible patients are scheduled to administered sintilimab 200mg D1 Q3W temozolomide 50mg/m2 QD and radiotherapy 1Gy/1F D1/D2/D8/D15 Q3W for 4-6 cycles, then sintilimab for maintenance.

arms: Low-dose Radiotherapy Combined With Sintilimab and Temozolomide

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but the summary states every patient receives it (50 mg/m2 daily, metronomic-type dose) with sintilimab and low-dose RT; coded soc_backbone given in the single arm. An adjudicator could consider established_therapy_experiment because of the low daily dose schedule, but the investigational question centres on sintilimab plus low-dose RT. Plain 'glioblastoma' without IDH/WHO reference -> cns5 unclear.
